summary: Pontiac‑William Holliday School District 105 urges the FCC to preserve and strengthen E‑Rate, rejecting any sunset, reduction, or restriction of the program and emphasizing the essential role of broadband for safety, instruction, and equity. The commenters urge the FCC to preserve the E‑Rate program, oppose any sunset or unnecessary narrowing of eligibility, and support continued investment in school connectivity.
